On my last day at work, not only did my manager not say goodbye, our last conversation was filled with tension. I don't have any attachment to this company anymore but it still left a bad taste in my mouth.
</message>

<passage>
In conversation we should give good heed to what is said, and in every enterprise we should attend to what is done. In the latter case, at once look to the end in view, and, in the former, note the meaning intended.
</passage>

output.reason: Encourages understanding intentions and actions, which may help reflect on the manager's behavior.
